name: slint-monorepo
description: Monorepo for the slint Agent Skills linter (CLI, VS Code extension, docs).

scripts.coverage:cli:html: env CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 RUST_TEST_THREADS=1 cargo llvm-cov --workspace --html --output-dir coverage/html --ignore-filename-regex='/.cargo/|/rustc/'
scripts.coverage:cli:lcov: env CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 RUST_TEST_THREADS=1 cargo llvm-cov --workspace --lcov --output-path coverage/lcov.info --ignore-filename-regex='/.cargo/|/rustc/'
scripts.format: pnpm format:cli && pnpm format:vscode && pnpm format:docs
scripts.package:vscode: turbo run build --filter=slint-vscode && pnpm --filter slint-vscode package
